payload.summary: Codex reviewed the card face. First pass caught a real consequence of marking .card-face aria-hidden: onCardSeen announced only the rank, so the suit became sight-only — a screen-reader user got strictly less than the face shows. Added spokenCard()/suitOf() and routed both announcement paths through it (dealt cards and the opening burn), with the burn callout also gaining the suit glyph so visible and spoken text carry the same information. Re-review APPROVE (run szn323a0), which also confirmed fast-forward does not double-announce. Unreported bug found and fixed along the way: the centre pip was never centred — the old grid areas put it in column two, at x=62 on a 92px card.
